bull_points.claim: The stock trades at NTM TEV/EBITDA 4.8x against a HETEROGENEOUS peer median of 8.45x — the decisive question for the human is whether that gap is EARNED or RESIDUAL, since the peer set spans $785M–$63.6B caps (81x) and is not a clean benchmark.

key_unknowns: No forward adjusted EV/EBITDA or company adjusted-EPS guide is available at the drawdown, and the trailing P/E is NM — the overshoot-vs-terminal multiple question cannot be resolved on a clean forward basis (the 4.1x trailing figure is also struck on EBITDA-plus-rent, not reported EBITDA).

Covenant headroom is opaque: the governing Consolidated Leverage Ratio ceiling is 3.75x (step-up to 4.25x) but the covenant-basis EBITDA is UNDISCLOSED and net-debt/EBITDA sits at 4.0x on CIQ's basis — whether the company is inside its maintenance covenant is unresolved (a bearish disclosure gap).

The $375M term loan maturing December 2026 and the $537M securitization facility maturing March 2028 are to be repaid from free cash flow and liquidity per management, but the filing states no ≤12m maturity figure — refinancing/repayment certainty is unverified.

2027 is explicitly un-guided; management claims new-business growth will 'offset much, if not all' of automation-driven erosion with stable-to-improved margins — the central thesis variable has no quantified outlook.

Single-segment (Software & Programming) reporting means no segment-EBITDA breakout to isolate the margin/economics of the new AI-influenced $3B book vs the compressing traditional base — the mix claim cannot be independently verified (a bearish disclosure gap).

The peer set is HETEROGENEOUS (caps $785M–$63.6B, 81x span); every peer multiple is a confidence-gated input, not a clean benchmark, so the EARNED-vs-RESIDUAL split of the discount is for the human to judge, not computed here.

business_description.value: Concentrix Corporation designs, builds, and runs integrated customer experience (CX) solutions worldwide. It provides CX process optimization, technology innovation and design engineering, front- and back-office automation, analytics, and business transformation services to clients in various industry verticals comprising technology and consumer electronics; retail, travel, and e-commerce; communications and media; banking, financial services, and insurance; and healthcare. The company also offers customer lifecycle management; CX and user experience strategy and design; data analytics, enterprise intelligence, artificial intelligence readiness, and actionable insights; digital operations, such as B2B sales, performance marketing, customer loyalty, trust and safety, collections, and financial compliance; and GenAI and agentic AI technologies. In addition, it provides digital transformation services that designs and engineer CX solutions to enable efficient customer self-service and build customer loyalty; customer engagement solutions and services that address the entirety of the customer lifecycle; and AI technology that can intelligently act on customer intent to improve customer experience with non-human engagement. Further, the company offers self-service GenAI and agentic AI assistants for applications in data analysis, language translations, and internal chatbots; voice of the customer and analytics solutions to gather and analyze customer feedback; analytics and consulting solutions that synthesize data and provide professional insight to improve clients’ customer experience strategies; specialized support to specific industry verticals; and back office services that support clients in non-customer facing areas. It serves technology and consumer electronics, retail, travel and e-commerce, communications and media, banking, financial services and insurance, healthcare, and other industries. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Newark, California.

historical_forecast_error.eligibility_note: Each observation is the consensus on the eve of the result — lead time ~0 — so it measures last-mile surprise: a cross-check on scenario severity and on how wrong late consensus has been. It is NOT a distribution of how far consensus moves over a holding period; that needs point-in-time consensus snapshots, which no Estimates Report carries. Each 'actual' is the figure CIQ's Estimates set against its own consensus, which is often NOT the line the financial statements report; `accounting_basis` names the filer's accounting STANDARD (US GAAP, IFRS), never the basis of that actual.
historical_forecast_error.usage_note: EBIT- or EBITDA-level shock today: error_per_forecast_revenue × today's revenue consensus. Revenue × margin scenario: the SAME year's Revenue pct_error and ratio_error, kept together. ratio_error alone answers how wrong the margin (or capex-intensity) forecast was, and multiplied by revenue it drops the revenue miss's effect. Exact identity: error_per_forecast_revenue = ratio_error + (actual ÷ actual revenue) × (actual revenue ÷ forecast revenue − 1).
